decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the gable end of the roof extension hereby approved elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the gable end of the roof extension hereby approved, or in the northeastern or southwestern flank walls of the rear dormer hereby approved, without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extension to dwellinghouse incorporating 2 velux roof lights to front elevation, one window to side elevation.
